title: Liberia: MOE Unveils Digital System to Strengthen School Monitoring Nationwide
why_not: The Geo-Mapping M&E system and the HAK Technology Monitoring and Supervision System are one system, a school-monitoring tool (instruction, teacher attendance, teaching materials) holding no record per learner; its Government funding through the Public Sector Investment Program is already held, and only the approximately US$300,000 value is new.
